title: The turned faces
notes: Bible 7.1: near the Cradle every carved face in the Knot is turned toward the centre. A runic line the player can half-read; the Knot as a sentence (3.2).

pages.text:
(Every carved face along the wall is turned the same way, toward the centre. Beneath the nearest, in runes you only half read:)

THE SENTENCE HAS NO END. DO NOT LOOK FOR IT.
